name: NOTICE OF CONTINUANCE - CITY COUNCIL OVERRIDE OF INCONSISTENCY DETERMINATION BY THE AIRPORT LAND USE COMMISSION OF ORANGE COUNTY
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF CONTINUATION OF
  PUBLIC HEARING
Donald P. Wagner
Mayor
  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that at its meeting held on
Lynn Schott  July 25, 2017, the City Council continued the public
Mayor Pro Tempore
  hearing relative to the CITY COUNCIL OVERRIDE OF
Melissa Fox
  INCONSISTENCY DETERMINATION BY THE AIRPORT
Councilmember  LAND USE COMMISSION OF ORANGE COUNTY
  (Agenda Item No. 3.2) to September 12, 2017 at 4 p.m. or
Jeffrey Lalloway  soon thereafter to hear public comments regarding the
Councilmember
  proposed actions.
Christina Shea
Councilmember

  Affidavit of Posting:

  STATE OF CALIFORNIA )
  CITY OF IRVINE  ) SS
  COUNTY OF ORANGE  )

  I DECLARE UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY that I, Molly McLaughlin, am
  employed by the City of Irvine, in the City Clerk's Office; and that I posted
  this Notice in the posting book located in the Public Safety Lobby of City
  Hall, One Civic Center Plaza.
